grades.lower_bound_mechanism: Cofactor Bound: smooth-cofactor replacement m=D·c with P(m)=tau*, plus TERM lemma (valid m in [a_1,a_n] is a term) and blocker-monotonicity contradiction, giving every essential prime <= a_1
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: Valid set V = union of divisibility classes for minimal transversals over finite prime ground set, hence periodic mod L = product of essential primes; sequence is increasing enumeration of V from a_1, T = |V mod L|
grades.notes: Blocker/transversal reduction and stabilization are argued in full generality. The crux (finiteness) is genuinely proved via the Cofactor Bound with all cases (D<=a_1 and D>a_1) handled; Lemmas A, B, C are proved, not merely tested. Periodicity is established from n=1, not eventually. Numerics are supplementary only.
